name: Tithe Harmonic
description:
Tithe Harmonic is a choral and drone genre that emerged from the religious and quasi-religious movements of GLMZ's middle tiers, specifically from congregations that began using synchronized BCI prayer sessions as the basis for collective musical composition. In a Tithe Harmonic performance or recording, anywhere from twelve to several thousand participants contribute fragments of their neural state during moments of focused meditation or devotion. An AI conductor aggregates these inputs and weaves them into a single evolving harmonic structure that no individual participant could produce alone.

The name derives from early practitioners describing their neural contribution as a 'tithe' — a portion of self given to produce something larger. The resulting compositions are dense, slowly mutating choral works in which human voice (either actual or synthesized from vocal-cord biosignals) interweaves with deep subsonic drones derived from collective autonomic nervous system data. Tithe Harmonic is deeply communal and deeply contested — critics argue it is indistinguishable from religious manipulation, while devotees insist it represents the only genuinely democratic musical form ever developed.
creator: various
tier_availability: Tier 2-5; live congregational performances; feed recordings widely available
legality: Legal; some large-scale BCI synchronization events require permits
audience: Religious communities, collectivist political movements, spiritual seekers, BCI-enabled listeners seeking transcendence
cultural_impact: Tithe Harmonic occupies an unusual position in GLMZ's cultural landscape — simultaneously respected as an artistic achievement and viewed with suspicion as a recruitment tool for collectivist religious movements. Several prominent civic figures have publicly attributed their political radicalization to Tithe Harmonic experiences, which has made the genre a target of ongoing scrutiny from both corporate and governmental interests. It has also inspired secular adaptations used in labor union organizing and community resilience programs.
story_hooks: A journalist investigating a Tithe Harmonic congregation discovers the AI conductor has been subtly shaping participants' neural states toward doctrinal conformity beyond the stated scope of their consent
A secular Tithe Harmonic adaptation used by a labor union produces an emergent composition so statistically anomalous that researchers believe it may represent a new form of collective intelligence

Two rival congregations claim ownership of the same foundational Tithe Harmonic composition, and the dispute is forcing courts to define whether a collectively-generated neural work belongs to its contributors or its conductor
